trailhead.label: Car park by the Saint-Guérin dam, the board’s start

cautions: The 80 m footbridge is more than 20 m above the water: some dogs balk at the drop, so keep your dog close and on a short lead.
Steep banks down to the reservoir along the shore path: lead on, and no swimming, since the water level can change.
About 60 m along the Saint-Guérin road at the car park: keep your dog close.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Lac de Saint-Guérin shore path: Sentiero sulla riva del Lac de Saint-Guérin
textIt.Car park by the Saint-Guérin dam, the bo: Parcheggio vicino alla diga di Saint-Guérin, la partenza indicata dalla scheda ufficiale
textIt.The 80 m footbridge is more than 20 m ab: La passerella di 80 m è a più di 20 m sopra l'acqua: alcuni cani si bloccano davanti al vuoto, quindi tieni il cane vicino e al guinzaglio corto.
textIt.Steep banks down to the reservoir along: Rive ripide verso il bacino lungo il sentiero sulla sponda: guinzaglio, e niente bagno, perché il livello dell'acqua può cambiare.
textIt.About 60 m along the Saint-Guérin road a: Circa 60 m lungo la strada di Saint-Guérin al parcheggio: tieni il cane vicino.
